skills.name: mise-free-tools
skills.description: Work out kitchen back-office figures with the free Mise tools - check a supplier invoice line by line, estimate panic spend from emergency top-up buying, and calculate the unit cost of an ingredient from its pack price and size. Use when a user asks about an invoice discrepancy or overcharge, emergency or top-up purchasing costs, per-unit or per-pack ingredient costs, or wants a quick kitchen cost check before talking to Mise.
